verdict.rationale: Apple's pages do include some concrete spec-sheet items (core counts, 546GB/s memory bandwidth, Thunderbolt 5 speeds, display support) and comparative benchmark multipliers, but the pack shows heavy reliance on marketing adjectives ('blazing fast', 'ultimate choice') rather than a full technical datasheet. Missing for 10: published CPU/GPU clock speeds, TDP/power figures, an explicit AI TOPS number, and disclosed test conditions/methodology for the 'up to Nx faster' claims.
